messages:
Maya: quick design review — thinking through form validation & destructive confirms for Console v2. TL;DR: propose inline errors for field validation, compact "Required" label (not *), tooltips only for hints, typed confirm only for irreversible destructive (delete org), otherwise modal + undo. Thoughts? Joon: inline errs > tooltips for obvious validation (missing email). Tooltips ok for password requirements. Mobile: tooltips get clipped — prefer inline. Eli: accessibility nits: ensure role="alert" + aria-live="assertive" for inline error announcements, focus to first errored field on submit, do NOT rely on color alone for error state. For required marker, a11y: explicit "Required" text is better, but verbose visually. Suggest visually hide "Required" but keep sr-only text. Maya: agreed. Thinking of small "Required" pill vs asterisk. pill might add noise. sr-only is fine. Also want to avoid double messages (summary + inline) — summary should only appear on submit with multiple errors. Sam: regarding destructive flow: for per-row deletes (bulk) maybe a toast undo is enough. For team/org delete, typed confirm ("TYPE_THE_TEAM_NAME") makes ops real. Can we have copy suggestions? Maya: draft copy: "Delete team — This permanently deletes the team and all data. This action cannot be undone." Confirm button: "Delete team" (danger) + typed confirm placeholder "Type the team name to confirm". Secondary "Cancel". Undo toast: "Team deleted — Undo". Joon: small CSS nit — input error states need 8px gap below label, current 4px makes message cramped. Also ensure error icon sits to left of message on mobile. Eli: code snippet for aria pattern: ```html
There are errors in the form
Please enter a valid email address
``` Focus management: after submit, focus moves to #form-errors, then screen reader will read summary. Maya: love that. Joon — can we use aria-errormessage instead of aria-describedby for modern browsers? Joon: yes, aria-errormessage is good; include both for wider compat: ```html ``` Eli: one more: don't use title tooltips for error messages — they aren't read by screen readers. Sam: action item: Maya to update mockups; Joon to tweak spacing & use aria-errormessage; Eli to add a11y checklist; I'll add to the PR description. :thumbsup: ops-bot: Created task #4523 for accessibility checklist (assignee: Eli).
